questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der var flere forskellige ting, som gjorde, at jeg endte med at vælge Singapore. For det første var det vigtigt for mig, at det var et sted, der var sikkert og rent. For det andet ville jeg gerne hen til et universitet med et højt fagligt niveau. Endeligt er Singapore et godt sted at rejse fra, hvis man vil rundt i Asien.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg havde et fuldstændig fantastisk udvekslingsophold. Jeg kan virkelig kun anbefale det.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Da jeg først ankom til Singapore, var det relativt nemt. Alt frem til at jeg ankom var et stort rod.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: NUS kommunikerede primært via mail.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Det var ret nemt. Jeg fandt en lejlighed med nogle andre fra Skandinavien via Facebook-siden "Danskere i Singapore".

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det er dyrt at leve i byen, men for mig var det alle pengene værd. Det er så meget nemmere at komme rundt og opleve byen. Dog skal man være indstillet på, at der selvfølgelig er et fællesskab ved campus, som man går glip af. Det var ikke noget, som jeg oplevede som et problem. Alle er meget åbne og snaksaglige, så man finder nemt nye bekendtskaber.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg missede desværre ansøgningsfristen til housing på campus, men det er mit indtryk, at dem, der søgte det, fik en plads. Jeg kan ikke rigtig udtale mig om forholdene, men der er vist ret stor forskel alt afhængig af, hvor man ender. Tilsyneladende skulle U-town og det område være bedst.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Ret forfærdeligt. Husk at læse alt igennem, de sender, meget grundigt.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Tung og bureaukratisk.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Send dem en mail. De svarer ret hurtigt.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: De gik fint.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Læs ALT igennem.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Niveauet var højere end på KU.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Deres undervisning er væsentlig anderledes end København. Man skal være indstillet på, at der er meget pensum. Samtidig har man 'Class Participation', som typisk tæller 20 % af ens samlede karakter. Man har navneskilte i timerne, så de kan kalde en ud. Man skal også være klar på, at de kører ca. 3 timer (klokketimer - der er ikke akademisk kvarter) med én fem-minutters pause. OBS der er ret koldt på universitetet - tag en sweater med.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Intellectual Property & Human Rights, Aviation Financing, Behavioral law and economics og Energy Arbitration

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Energy Arbitration - underviserne er fantastiske og enormt underholdende. Jeg kan virkelig kun anbefale det.

questions.answer: Jeg deltog ikke i det, så jeg ved det ikke. Det var sikkert fint.

questions.answer: N/A

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Tag ud og vandre. Rejs rundt i Asien.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Rejs rundt i Asien.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: De er mere åbne, end man skulle tro. Bare snak med dem. De skal nok invitere dig på kaffe/frokost/andet.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: De kan godt virke ret uhøflige.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Madkulturen. Der er virkelig meget god mad.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
De virker mere strikse på papir, end de er. Det hele skal nok gå. 

Få rejst!

NYD DET!

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer:
De står i venstre side på rulletrapperne. 

Kom tidligt til Singtel og få dit telefonnummer. Husk pas. 

Man må hverken drikke vand eller spise på metroen.

Brug MRT til at komme rundt. Du behøver ikke et metrokort. 

Husk paraply - det regner absurd meget. 

Tag til Georgetown i Boat Quay. Der er vildt mange udvekslingsstuderende, og alkoholen er billig. 

Husk kontanter til Hawker Centre.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Alle de nye mennesker, jeg har mødt.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Fagligt - man skal virkelig vænne sig til, at de kører efter common law.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Nej.

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
